sources.entry: mStream - Music streaming server with GUI management tools. Runs on Mac, Windows, and Linux. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Nodejs

summary.one_liner: mStream Music is a self-hosted music streaming server with a web app, GUI admin tools, and desktop, mobile, and Docker options.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes mStream as a music streaming server that automatically fetches album art for your collection. It offers a Quick Sync feature that gives mobile apps and the desktop app access without port forwarding, DNS, or SSL setup, using Iroh. Optional P2P Discovery pulls similarity data from other mStream servers to suggest songs you don't own, and Federation lets servers share read access to each other's data. Extra features listed include torrent client integration, yt-dlp audio downloads, DLNA support, automatic backups to a connected drive, transcoding, Auto DJ, lyrics search, and jukebox mode. The server runs without sign-in until a user is added, after which it becomes password protected.
use_cases: stream my personal music collection from home
self-host a music server for family or friends
play music in a browser or mobile app from my own server
download YouTube audio into my music library
discover similar songs to what I listen to
back up my music library to another drive
how_to_run: Download the standalone binary for Windows, macOS, or Linux from the project's releases (see install docs)
Or run the Docker image (LinuxServer.io maintains it; see Docker instructions)
Or install from source following the 'Install From Source' guide linked in the README
stack: Rust (Lofty tag reader, Symphonia audio decoder)
notable: Quick Sync gives zero-configuration remote access without port forwarding, DNS, or SSL setup
Federation and P2P Discovery let servers share music metadata and stream discovered songs
Standalone bundles per platform with a tray app and a headless server option, no Electron
Built-in torrent client integration and yt-dlp audio downloads
caveats: Quick Sync only works with mobile apps and the upcoming desktop app; the webapp does not work through it
Local server audio playback does not work in Docker
P2P Discovery only suggests songs; you must find and acquire them yourself
